'''Lord Hel'nurath''' is a level 62 [[rare mob|rare]] [[elite]] [[demon]] summoned in [[Dire Maul]] West.

A member of the [[nathrezim]] ruling over the world of [[Xoroth]]. You have to defeat him and one of his [[dreadsteed]]s to be able to summon a [[dreadsteed]] on the quest line for the [[warlock]] epic [[mount]].
